subject: Executive sponsor coverage & EB calendar sync for Nebula MAP and close
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@nebulacloud.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual action plan + exec sponsor for Nebula close

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our procurement and platform teams ran the sandbox workload this morning and we want to push toward a firm Q3 close. To do that I want to align on a short mutual action plan (MAP), validate technical evaluation criteria, and line up executive stakeholders for a final EB (executive briefing) to sign off on timelines.

Proposed high-level MAP (very rough):
- 8/03–8/10: finalize Eval criteria and run targeted performance tests (kv-prefixs, latency at 99th)
- 8/11–8/18: legal & procurement redlines + pricing confirmation
- 8/19–8/25: executive briefing & SLA sign-off
- 8/26–8/31: contract sign and PO issuance

We have two suggested exec sponsors on our side: Tomas Erickson (VP Product) and Ella Moreno (CISO). Can Redwood provide an exec-level sponsor (VP/GM) and a single technical champion for the EB? Also: do you have a draft MAP we can review and a short checklist for the EB so our SOC/compliance team knows what evidence to expect?

Attached: NEB-MAP-draft-v3.xlsx (initial MAP), nebula-eval-criteria.pdf.

Goal: target a final EB the week of 8/16 — ideally a one-hour slot that covers exec alignment + open procurement items. Availability on our side is flexible during mornings PST.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Platform & Cloud Partnerships
Nebula Cloud

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@nebulacloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + exec sponsor for Nebula close

Samir —

Appreciate the clear timeline. I've pulled together a short MAP template and an EB checklist that map to Redwood's standard close playbook. High-level notes below; I'm attaching our MAP draft and the SOC2 summary you asked about.

Proposed Redwood coverage for EB:
- Exec sponsor: Priya Natarajan, Head of Strategic Accounts (will run the EB)
- Technical champion (DE): Marcus Lin, Solutions Architect (will run the performance & KV test sections)

MAP updates (from your draft):
- Move the performance validation window to 8/04–8/11 so we can run a focused 24/72h load test and get kernel selection validated before legal review.
- Recommend a single EB date range: 8/17–8/19 (Redwood execs available mornings PT).
- Procurement milestone: we’ll document required PO terms and a DocuSign timeline tied to 8/26 contract signature.

EB checklist (brief):
- Attendees: vendor exec sponsor + customer exec sponsor, technical champions, procurement/legal observers
- Artifacts: performance test results (tokens/sec, 99th latency), cost/run model, SOC2 summary, data flow diagram, SSO/KMS notes
- Decisions: SLA targets, data residency/retention, contract redline owner

I'll attach: "NEB-MAP-draft-v3.xlsx" (Redwood annotated), "SOC2-summary-Redwood.pdf", and a one-page EB checklist. Marcus — can you review the evaluation criteria and confirm what telemetry/benchmarks you want from Nebula's sandbox?

Priya
Priya Natarajan
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@nebulacloud.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + exec sponsor for Nebula close

Samir / team —

Thanks for the criteria doc. Quick technical asks so we can scope the perf run (we'll include these in the MAP):
- Provide 24h trace of production-like sequence lengths and a sample prompt set (anonymized).
- Expected QPS and peak burst size for the evaluation window.
- Any hard requirements for P99 latency (ms) and tail tolerance.

For the bench I propose we execute: steady-state 1hr test + three 30m burst runs. I'll own the test harness and results doc. Our earliest slot to run the focused validation is 8/05–8/06 (we'll need Nebula to enable a test key and whitelist Redwood test IPs).

Attachments requested: if you can share the sandbox traffic slice and a short network whitelist for the 8/05 run, we can turn results around within 48 hours.

> On Aug 3, 2027, at 9:05 AM, Priya Natarajan wrote:
> > Marcus — can you review the evaluation criteria and confirm what telemetry/benchmarks you want from Nebula's sandbox?

Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@nebulacloud.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-05T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + exec sponsor for Nebula close

Samir —

I can take point on procurement and pricing milestones. A few quick items to move toward locking the EB:
- Can Nebula confirm the procurement contact (name + email) so we can engage for commercial redlines?
- We should align on a single EB agenda: 30m exec alignment (Priya/Tomas), 20m tech deep dive (Marcus), 10m procurement next steps.
- For scheduling: propose 8/18 09:00–10:00 PT as our preferred slot. If that works for you, I'll send a calendar hold and a short preread with the high-level pricing model and acceptance criteria.

If Nebula needs an LOI/terms memo before the EB, we can provide a short one pager and a DocuSign readiness window so legal has something to react to immediately after the meeting.

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@nebulacloud.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-09T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + exec sponsor for Nebula close

Team —

All good on our side. Confirming:
- Exec sponsors: Tomas Erickson and Ella Moreno will attend.
- Procurement contact: Mira Patel <mira.patel@nebulacloud.com> (copied on a separate thread to start redlines).
- EB date/time: 8/18 09:00–10:00 PT is confirmed.
- Test window: we'll enable the sandbox slice and whitelist for Redwood on 8/05 as Marcus requested (traffic slice will be sent by EOD 8/04).

Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Platform & Cloud Partnerships
Nebula Cloud
